reviewMethod: State-specific server-side evidence review against the Wave 4 remediation requirements: current tax, housing, labor, hazard/resilience and transportation sources; stronger metro/place comparison; dated review metadata; canonical/schema integrity; and sitemap qualification

reviewed.reason: Idaho now has current 5.3% individual-income-tax evidence, current Census housing benchmarks, July 2026 official labor-force evidence, current state mitigation authority and ITD transit evidence plus distinct Boise, Coeur d'Alene, Idaho Falls and Pocatello comparison guidance.

Oregon now has current Department of Revenue personal-income-tax evidence, current OHCS housing-supply and affordability evidence, a July 2026 Oregon Employment Department labor-market checkpoint, the effective 2025-2030 state hazard plan and ODOT public-transportation evidence plus distinct Portland, Salem, Eugene, Bend and Medford comparison guidance.

Utah now has current 4.5% individual-income-tax evidence, current Census housing benchmarks, July 2026 Department of Workforce Services employment evidence, state hazard-mitigation authority and UDOT transit evidence plus distinct Wasatch Front, Provo-Orem and St. George comparison guidance.
